messages:
anya: Tiny tribute to desk supplies — who's the MVP? Stapler, sticky notes, or tape dispenser? Cast one emoji vote.
Mike: `stapler` forever. binds projects and people. :laughing: 
devon: sticky notes. they are tiny flags of ambition. :memo: 
sophia: tape dispenser — quiet hero. also dramatic when it runs out. :cry: 
jordan: stapler :thumbsup: 
Mike: also shoutout to the weird pen we all borrow and never return.
devon: can we have ceremonial retirements for dead markers?
sophia: poll time? quick reaction votes only.
lunchbot: Poll created: 'Desk Supply MVP' — 🖇️ stapler, 🗒️ sticky notes, 🧷 tape dispenser. Voting open 2h.
anya: winner gets a tiny trophy (paperclip glued to a post-it) :trophy: 
jordan: nominating the power adapter as honorary mention.
sophia: one-liners: 'Stuck? Use the stapler.'
Mike: 'When in doubt, sticky-note it.'
devon: 'Tape: the duct tape of the paper world.'
anya: ok enough office philosophy, someone refill the glue sticks pls.
jordan: filing this under 'office anthropology' :museum: 
sophia: :wave: heading to kitchen to hide a sticker on the stapler. report back with photos.
Mike: photos or it didn't happen.
devon: posted a blurry close-up of the stapler with caption 'hero'. :camera_with_flash: 
anya: :heart: thanks team — tiny traditions make the week.
